title: Compiled scope→capability DAG, schema version 3
description: The JSONB stored in compiled_policies.dag. Version 3 (Phase 4) is ADDITIVE over version 2: every node carries `taint_policy` (trusted_sources materialized to the declared downstream agents when the manifest omits it) and every tool entry carries `binding_params`. The runtime still accepts version 2 with the documented defaults ( §2); recompiling produces version N+1 and mutates nothing.

dag_schema_version.description: 3 for policies compiled from Phase 4 on. Absent on Phase 1 rows; 2 on Phase 2/3 rows, which the runtime still accepts.

scope.description: The root agent name this policy was compiled for.

tools.description: Phase 1 key, retained. Flattened union across every reachable agent — sufficient for the human-readable scope catalog, NOT sufficient for a per-caller runtime decision. Use `nodes` for that.

data_classes.description: Phase 1 key, retained. Union across the closure.

downstream_agents.description: Phase 1 key, retained. The root agent's direct declarations.

hop_budget.description: Phase 1 key, retained. The root scope's budget; copied onto the session at consent.

paths.description: Phase 1 key, retained and still authoritative for HOP_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. A path's effective budget is the running minimum along it, which `edges` alone cannot express.

path.description: Ordered agent URIs from the root.

unresolved_downstream.description: Phase 1 key, retained. Declared downstream agents not registered at compile time. A delegation to one of these denies with EDGE_NOT_IN_DAG — it is not in `edges`.

source_agents.description: Phase 1 key, retained. Names of every agent in the closure; the key set of `nodes`.

nodes.description: ADDED IN V2. Per-agent capability, keyed by agent name. Answers 'may THIS caller reach THIS target' — the question the flattened `tools` list cannot answer, and the basis for OUT_OF_SCOPE.

tools.description: Only the tools THIS agent declared.

taint_policy.description: ADDED IN V3. This agent's provenance policy, defaults materialized.

edges.description: ADDED IN V2. The direct declared delegation edges in the closure. EDGE_NOT_IN_DAG is a membership test against this list, not an inference over `paths`.

max_hop_depth.description: The edge's own declared cap, from DownstreamDecl.max_hop_depth.

privileged.description: Consulted by Phase 4's tainted-into-privileged rule and by the transaction-token mint.

binding_params.description: ADDED IN V3. RFC 6901 pointers a transaction token binds; null = the whole parameter body. Only meaningful when privileged.

trusted_sources.description: fnmatch globs over target refs whose results are trusted_internal for this agent. Materialized: never absent in a compiled node.

block_tainted_into.description: "privileged", or a glob matched against the target ref or the call's data class, that a tainted context may not call.
